hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook that routes all swaps through Euler lending vaults, bypassing Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes from a proprietary curve invariant, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, and withdraws output tokens from another, returning a BeforeSwapDelta. Standard liquidity operations (addLiquidity, donate) and non-EulerSwap initializations are blocked by design.
